author: Roger Fingas
title: This week on AI: Apple's iPhone event on the horizon, a new Mac mini & more
text:
– A + This week on AI: Apple's iPhone event on the horizon, a new Mac mini & more By Roger Fingas
Friday, August 24, 2018, 09:16 pm PT (12:16 am ET)
Faint drums are already beating in the distance for Apple's September iPhone event, but this week rumors also emerged about a long-awaited Mac mini refresh, along with plans for lower-cost MacBooks.
To keep up on the latest in the Apple world, download the official AppleInsider app , and subscribe to our email newsletter .
